text:
incident-bot: 🔔 Pager: fncall_error_rate across west-1 shard exceeded 12% (alert id: alert-9832)
jamie: seeing huge error spikes on tool/function calls, looks concentrated to west-1 gpu-pool-3. latency up too. paging oncall.
lee: logs show a surge of structured-output heavy requests from a handful of tenants — top offenders: tenant-alfa, tenant-gamma.
pranav: confirmed. KV cache churn and repeated tool invocations. functioncall queue depth hitting 4x normal.
sara: putting a mitigation plan: 1) apply shard-level soft quarantine 2) reduce fncall concurrency 3) disable structured output for free tier (low risk). agree? :thinking_face:
jamie: agree. priority is to stop cascading failures and keep hosted api healthy. I'll take lead on applying gating.
lee: tagging cs-ops to prep customer comms for affected tenants. @cs-ops FYI, we may throttle or quarantine those tenants.
cs-ops: noted. will draft a short message if you confirm tenant list. want to avoid false positives.
jamie: we'll run targeted rate limits for tenant-alfa and tenant-gamma first, then broaden if needed. commands below.
jamie: ```
# apply tenant-level fncall soft-quarantine
POST /admin/v1/mitigations
Authorization: Bearer REDACTED_ADMIN_TOKEN
{
  "mode": "soft_quarantine",
  "scope": "tenant",
  "tenants": ["tenant-alfa","tenant-gamma"],
  "features": ["function_call","structured_output"],
  "limits": {"fncall_concurrency": 2, "structured_output": "disabled_free_tier"}
}
```
pranav: performing dry-run on staging control-plane to validate rules. will report back in ~2m.
deploy-bot: deploy started: mitigation-rules v2026.03.15-176345 applying to west-1/gpu-pool-3 (id: mr-6621)
pranav: dry-run passed for rule syntax, no schema errors. queuing apply to prod now.
jamie: applying now.
jamie: applied. watching metrics.
lee: fncall error-rate dropping to ~6% within 60s. throughput slightly reduced but overall healthy.
sara: great. start customer triage: tenant-alfa experiencing errors ~6% of calls before, reduce to 0.5% post-quarantine. we should offer guidance to reduce tool call fanout.
cs-ops: drafted message for tenant-alfa/gamma: short outage note + recommended mitigation (reduce parallel tool calls, move heavy structured-output to dedicated tier). sending to legal review.
pranav: follow-up: enabling fallback loopback for structured-output: when structured output disabled, model will return plain text + hint to upgrade. config:
```
feature_fallbacks:
  structured_output: {
    "behavior": "strip_to_text",
    "user_hint": "Structured JSON disabled on your plan; upgrade to Dedicated to restore."
  }
```
jamie: putting temporary quota increase on dedicated tenants to avoid collateral throttling (if they hit capacity due to reroutes).
lee: scheduling a canary rollback window in 30m in case impact grows.
sara: tracking incident severity as SEV2 for now. will escalate to SEV1 if error >10% again or >5 tenants impacted.
jamie: action items: (1) monitor error rate and latency across shards (lee) (2) CS comms & tenant messaging (cs-ops) (3) runbook writeup for mitigation steps to codify (pranav) (4) postmortem owner (sara).
pranav: I'll capture commands and timing in the runbook. snapshot: mitigation mr-6621 applied at 1763456872.
incident-bot: Note: paging resolved for alert-9832. auto-close scheduled in 15m if no regressions.
lee: leaving detailed logs in /var/logs/ingest/fncall-shard-west-1-176345.log and linking to the incident ticket.
cs-ops: sending tenant notices now. short note sent to tenant-alfa. will follow up with recommended config changes.
jamie: lowering live alerting to warning tier. keep channel open for 30m. thanks all. :teamwork:
